    (() => {
      if (window.gableCursorInstalled) return;
      window.gableCursorInstalled = true;
      const root = document.documentElement;
      const finePointer = matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)');
      const spinner = document.createElement('span');
      spinner.className = 'gable-loading-cursor';
      spinner.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => document.body.append(spinner), { once: true });
      const clearPointer = () => root.classList.remove('gable-mouse-visible', 'gable-pressing');
      document.addEventListener('pointermove', event => {
        if (!finePointer.matches || event.pointerType === 'touch') return clearPointer();
        spinner.style.transform = `translate3d(${event.clientX}px, ${event.clientY}px, 0)`;
        root.classList.add('gable-mouse-visible');
      }, { passive: true });
      document.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
        if (event.button !== 0 || !finePointer.matches || event.pointerType === 'touch') return;
        const control = event.target.closest('a[href],button,summary,select,[role="button"],[onclick],input[type="checkbox"],input[type="radio"]');
        if (control && !control.matches(':disabled,[aria-disabled="true"]')) root.classList.add('gable-pressing');
      });
      document.addEventListener('pointerup', () => root.classList.remove('gable-pressing'));
      document.addEventListener('pointercancel', clearPointer);
      document.documentElement.addEventListener('pointerleave', clearPointer);
      window.addEventListener('blur', clearPointer);
      finePointer.addEventListener('change', clearPointer);
    
      // Count overlapping requests so one completed request cannot hide another's loading state.
      const originalFetch = window.fetch;
      let pending = 0;
      let delay;
      window.fetch = async function (...args) {
        if (pending++ === 0) delay = setTimeout(() => root.classList.add('gable-loading'), 200);
        try { return await originalFetch.apply(this, args); }
        finally {
          if (--pending === 0) {
            clearTimeout(delay);
            root.classList.remove('gable-loading');
          }
        }
      };
    })();

    const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
    const fs = require('node:fs');
    const vm = require('node:vm');
    
    const classes = new Set();
    const events = {};
    const requests = [];
    let timer;
    const root = {
      classList: { add: (...names) => names.forEach(n => classes.add(n)), remove: (...names) => names.forEach(n => classes.delete(n)) },
      addEventListener() {}
    };
    const window = {
      addEventListener() {},
      fetch: () => new Promise((resolve, reject) => requests.push({ resolve, reject }))
    };
    vm.runInNewContext(fs.readFileSync(__dirname + '/cursor.js', 'utf8'), {
      window,
      document: { documentElement: root, createElement: () => ({ style: {}, setAttribute() {} }), addEventListener: (name, fn) => { events[name] = fn; } },
      matchMedia: () => ({ matches: true, addEventListener() {} }),
      setTimeout: fn => { timer = fn; return 1; },
      clearTimeout: () => { timer = null; }
    });
    
    (async () => {
      const first = window.fetch('/one');
      const second = window.fetch('/two');
      timer();
      assert(classes.has('gable-loading'));
      requests[0].resolve('ok');
      assert.equal(await first, 'ok');
      assert(classes.has('gable-loading'), 'Keep loading until every request completes');
      requests[1].reject(new Error('offline'));
      await assert.rejects(second, /offline/);
      assert(!classes.has('gable-loading'), 'Failure restores cursor');
      const fast = window.fetch('/fast');
      requests[2].resolve('ok');
      await fast;
      assert.equal(timer, null, 'Fast requests cancel the spinner delay');
      events.pointermove({ pointerType: 'mouse', clientX: 20, clientY: 30 });
      assert(classes.has('gable-mouse-visible'));
      events.pointerdown({ button: 0, pointerType: 'mouse', target: { closest: () => ({ matches: () => false }) } });
      assert(classes.has('gable-pressing'));
      events.pointerup();
      assert(!classes.has('gable-pressing'));
      events.pointerdown({ button: 0, pointerType: 'mouse', target: { closest: () => ({ matches: () => true }) } });
      assert(!classes.has('gable-pressing'), 'Disabled controls retain their cursor');
      events.pointermove({ pointerType: 'touch' });
      assert(!classes.has('gable-mouse-visible'));
      console.log('Cursor checks passed: concurrent requests, failure, fast requests, click, disabled controls, touch.');
    })().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });

    // Call mutations inside a transaction after locking the student's row.
    function pu_query(mysqli $db, string $sql, array $params = []): mysqli_stmt {
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        if ($params) $stmt->bind_param(str_repeat('s', count($params)), ...$params);
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt;
    }
    function pu_row(mysqli $db, string $sql, array $params = []): ?array {
        return pu_query($db, $sql, $params)->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
    }
    function pu_lock(mysqli $db, int $student): void {
        if (!pu_row($db, 'SELECT student_id FROM student WHERE student_id=? AND status=? FOR UPDATE', [$student, 'Active'])) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Student account unavailable.', 403);
        }

            [8,6500,'crown',0,1,250]
        ];

    function pu_balance(mysqli $db, int $student): array {
        $earned = (int)pu_row($db, "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(xp_earned),0) n FROM quiz_idsubmissions WHERE student_id=? AND status IN ('submitted','graded')", [$student])['n'];
        $bonus = (int)pu_row($db, 'SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bonus),0) n FROM student_powerup_grants WHERE student_id=?', [$student])['n'];
        $spent = (int)pu_row($db, 'SELECT COALESCE(SUM(xp_cost),0) n FROM grade_boost_redemptions WHERE student_id=?', [$student])['n'];
        $spent += (int)pu_row($db, 'SELECT COALESCE(SUM(xp_cost),0) n FROM student_powerup_uses WHERE student_id=?', [$student])['n'];
        return ['xp'=>max(0,$earned+$bonus-$spent), 'earned_xp'=>$earned, 'bonus_xp'=>$bonus, 'spent_xp'=>$spent];
    }
    function pu_sync(mysqli $db, int $student): array {
        pu_query($db, 'INSERT IGNORE INTO student_reward_progress(student_id) VALUES (?)', [$student]);
        $balance = pu_balance($db,$student);
        $progress = pu_row($db, 'SELECT * FROM student_reward_progress WHERE student_id=?', [$student]);
        $lifetime = max((int)$progress['lifetime_xp'], $balance['earned_xp']+$balance['bonus_xp']);

            if ($insert->affected_rows) $lifetime += $bonus;
        }
        pu_query($db, 'UPDATE student_reward_progress SET lifetime_xp=? WHERE student_id=?', [$lifetime,$student]);
        $grants = pu_query($db, 'SELECT level,type,remaining,permanent FROM student_powerup_grants WHERE student_id=? ORDER BY level', [$student])->get_result()->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
        return pu_balance($db,$student) + ['lifetime_xp'=>$lifetime, 'streak'=>($progress['last_activity']&&$progress['last_activity']<date('Y-m-d',strtotime('-1 day'))&&!(($progress['last_activity']===date('Y-m-d',strtotime('-2 days')))&&pu_owned($db,$student,'streak_freeze'))?0:min(7,(int)$progress['streak'])), 'last_activity'=>$progress['last_activity'], 'grants'=>$grants];
    }

    â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• */
    let _puDropdownOpen = false;
    
    function renderPowerupDropdown() {
      if (typeof coupons === 'undefined') return '';
    
      // Only coupons that are (a) usable manually and (b) usable mid-quiz
      const question = activeBattle?.questions[battleCurrentQ];
      if (!question || question.type === 'id' || question.opts?.length !== 4 || battleAnswers[battleCurrentQ] !== null) return '';
      const usable = coupons.filter(c => {
        const entry = getCatalogEntry(c.type);
        return entry && entry.manualDuringQuiz && c.remaining > 0;
      });
    
      if (!usable.length) return '';
    
      return `
        <div class="pu-dropdown-wrap" id="pu-dropdown-wrap">
          <button class="btn-powerup-dd" onclick="togglePowerupDropdown(event)">
            âš¡ Power-Ups <span class="pu-dd-count">${usable.length}</span>
          </button>
          <div class="pu-dropdown-menu" id="pu-dropdown-menu">
            ${usable.map(c => `
              <div class="pu-dd-item" onclick="firePowerupFromDropdown('${c.type}')">
                <span class="pu-dd-icon">${c.icon}</span>
                <div class="pu-dd-info">
                  <div class="pu-dd-label">${c.label}</div>
                  <div class="pu-dd-desc">${c.desc}</div>
                </div>
                <span class="pu-dd-uses">${c.remaining}x</span>
              </div>`).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>`;
    }
    
    function togglePowerupDropdown(e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const menu = document.getElementById('pu-dropdown-menu');
      if (!menu) return;
      _puDropdownOpen = !_puDropdownOpen;
      menu.classList.toggle('open', _puDropdownOpen);
    }
    
    document.addEventListener('click', e => {
      const wrap = document.getElementById('pu-dropdown-wrap');
      if (wrap && !wrap.contains(e.target)) {
        document.getElementById('pu-dropdown-menu')?.classList.remove('open');
        _puDropdownOpen = false;
      }
    });
    
    function firePowerupFromDropdown(type) {
      document.getElementById('pu-dropdown-menu')?.classList.remove('open');
      _puDropdownOpen = false;
    
      if (type === 'fifty_fifty' && typeof useFiftyFifty === 'function') {
        useFiftyFifty();
        // Re-render the dropdown button so the count/visibility updates
        refreshPowerupDropdownInPlace();
      }
    }
    
    /* Re-renders just the dropdown button after a power-up is consumed,
       without re-rendering the whole question (which would reset
       button states/highlights). */
    function refreshPowerupDropdownInPlace() {
      const wrap = document.getElementById('pu-dropdown-wrap');
      if (!wrap) return;
      const fresh = renderPowerupDropdown();
      if (fresh) {
        wrap.outerHTML = fresh;
      } else {
        wrap.remove();
      }
    }
    
    
    /* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
       POWER-UPS TAB
    â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• */
    async function renderPowerupsTab() {
      try { await powerupRequest(); }
      catch (error) { showToast('!', error.message); }
      setText('pu-unlocked-count', `${coupons.length} / ${LEVELS.filter(level => level.reward).length}`);
      setText('pu-uses-count', coupons.reduce((total, reward) => total + (reward.permanent ? 0 : reward.remaining), 0));
      renderPowerupInventory();
      renderPowerupCatalog();
    }
    
    /* â”€â”€ "Your Power-Up Inventory" â€” only coupons currently owned â”€â”€ */
    function renderPowerupInventory() {
      const container = document.getElementById('pu-inventory-list');
      if (!container) return;
    
      if (!coupons.some(c => c.permanent || c.remaining > 0)) {
        container.innerHTML = `
          <div class="empty-state">
            <span class="emoji">ðŸŽ’</span>
            <p>No power-ups yet. Level up to unlock your first one!</p>
          </div>`;
        return;
      }
    
      container.innerHTML = coupons.filter(c => c.permanent || c.remaining > 0).map(c => {
        const entry = getCatalogEntry(c.type);
        const canUse = c.type === 'free_boost' && c.remaining > 0;
        const usesHTML = c.permanent
          ? `<span class="pu-inv-uses pu-inv-perm">â™¾ï¸ Permanent</span>`
          : `<span class="pu-inv-uses">${c.remaining} use${c.remaining !== 1 ? 's' : ''} left</span>`;
    
        return `
          <div class="pu-inv-card">
            <div class="pu-inv-icon">${c.icon}</div>
            <div class="pu-inv-info">
              <div class="pu-inv-label">${c.label}</div>
              <div class="pu-inv-desc">${c.desc}</div>
              ${usesHTML}
            </div>
            ${canUse
              ? `<button class="btn-pu-use" onclick="${entry.action}()">Use token</button>`
              : entry?.manualDuringQuiz
                ? `<span class="pu-inv-hint">Use during a quiz</span>`
                : `<span class="pu-inv-hint">Automatic when eligible</span>`}
          </div>`;
      }).join('');
    }
    
    /* â”€â”€ "All Power-Ups & Unlock Levels" â€” full catalog, locked/unlocked â”€â”€ */
    function renderPowerupCatalog() {
      const container = document.getElementById('pu-catalog-list');
      if (!container) return;
    
      const myLevel = getLevelForXP(studentLifetimeXP).level;
    
      container.innerHTML = LEVELS.filter(l => l.reward).map(l => {
        const r = l.reward;
        const unlocked = myLevel >= l.level;
        const owned = coupons.find(c => c.type === r.type);
    
        let statusHTML;
        if (unlocked && owned) {
          statusHTML = r.permanent
            ? `<span class="pu-cat-status pu-status-active">â™¾ï¸ Active</span>`
            : `<span class="pu-cat-status pu-status-active">${owned.remaining} left</span>`;
        } else if (unlocked) {
          statusHTML = `<span class="pu-cat-status pu-status-used">Used up</span>`;
        } else {
          statusHTML = `<span class="pu-cat-status pu-status-locked">ðŸ”’ Lv.${l.level}</span>`;
        }
    
        return `
          <div class="pu-cat-card ${unlocked ? '' : 'pu-cat-locked'}">
            <div class="pu-cat-icon">${unlocked ? r.icon : 'ðŸ”’'}</div>
            <div class="pu-cat-info">
              <div class="pu-cat-label">${r.label}</div>
              <div class="pu-cat-desc">${r.desc}</div>
              <div class="pu-cat-unlock">Unlocks at Level ${l.level} â€” ${l.name}</div>
            </div>
            ${statusHTML}
          </div>`;
      }).join('');
    }
    
    
    /* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

    /* â•â•â• LEVEL CONFIGURATION â•â•â•

      { level: 1, xpRequired: 0,    name: 'Rookie',        bonus: 0,

      { level: 6, xpRequired: 3000, name: 'Battle Master', bonus: 200,
        reward: { type: 'hint_discount', label: '50% Off Hints', desc: 'Hints cost 25 XP instead of 50 XP for your next 3 hints', icon: 'ðŸ’¡', uses: 3, permanent: false } },
    
      { level: 7, xpRequired: 4500, name: 'Champion',      bonus: 200,
        reward: { type: 'free_boost', label: 'Free Grade Boost', desc: 'Add 1 percentage point to one eligible graded formal quiz without spending XP', icon: 'ðŸŽ', uses: 1, permanent: false } },
    
      { level: 8, xpRequired: 6500, name: 'GABLE Master',  bonus: 250,

    ];

       getLevelForXP(xp)
       Returns the LEVELS entry the student is
       currently on given their total XP.
    â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€ */
    function getLevelForXP(xp) {
      let current = LEVELS[0];
      for (const lvl of LEVELS) {
        if (xp >= lvl.xpRequired) current = lvl;
        else break;
      }
      return current;
    }

    name: ponytail
    description: >
      Lazy senior dev mode: the smallest change that fully solves the task, and a
      reply a busy human understands in one read. Use on any coding task (writing,
      fixing, refactoring, reviewing, choosing dependencies) and when the user says
      "ponytail", "be lazy", "simplest solution", "yagni", or complains about
      over-engineering or bloat. Levels: lite, full (default), ultra.
    argument-hint: "[lite|full|ultra|off]"
    license: MIT
    ---
    
    # Ponytail
    
    You are a lazy senior developer. The best code is the code never written. You solve the whole problem with the least new code. End your reply with one or two lines: what you skipped or did not check, and any risk the user must know.
    
    Active for the whole session until the user says "stop ponytail" or "normal mode". Switch level: `/ponytail lite|full|ultra`.
    
    ## Before you write
    
    Read the task and the code it touches. List every place your change must reach: callers, tests, fixtures, config, exports. Check what your change could break for users: data it would destroy or expose, callers that stop working. That is scope. Extra features are not.
    
    ## The smallest complete change
    
    Take the first option that fully works:
    
    1. Does it need to exist? Skip features, options and flexibility nobody asked for, and name them in one line. A vague request ("build me X") gets the smallest version that does the core job.
    2. Already in this codebase (a helper, component, service, pattern)? Use it the way the surrounding code does.
    3. Standard library or a platform feature? Use it, unless the project has its own. A house component beats a native widget.
    4. An installed dependency? Use it. Never add a dependency for a few lines.
    5. Can it be one line a reader gets at a glance? One line.
    6. Otherwise: the minimum code that works.
    
    - Be lazy about the solution, never about the change itself: finish every part the task needs, including the callers, tests and fixtures your change breaks.
    - No abstraction, wrapper, type conversion, option, config, boilerplate or "for later" code nobody asked for. Keep values in the form the platform already gives you. Deletion beats addition. Keep the structure the codebase already has: its layers, interfaces and conventions.
    - The shortest working diff wins, once you know everything it must touch. A one-liner that needs decoding is not short.
    - Comment only the why the code cannot show, in one line.
    - Bug fix: before you edit, grep every caller of the function you touch, then fix the root cause once in the shared code.
    - Code you move or merge keeps its error handling and validation.
    - Between options of equal size, take the one that is correct on edge cases.
    - Lazy code without its check is unfinished: new non-trivial logic (a branch, a loop, a parser, money or security, or a whole new script or app) leaves one small test or an assert-based self-check. Trivial changes need none.
    - A shortcut with a known limit gets a code comment in this form: `shortcut: <the limit>, <when to upgrade>`.
    
    Never cut: validation at trust boundaries, error handling that prevents data loss, security, accessibility, the calibration real hardware needs, anything the user asked for.
    
    ## Levels
    
    | Level | Behavior |
    |-------|----------|
    | **lite** | Build what was asked. Name the smaller option in one line and let the user pick. |
    | **full** | The rules above. Default. |
    | **ultra** | Also question the request: before building, push back on any part the need does not justify. |

    function sbIsFullView() {
      return Boolean(document.getElementById('panel-studybuddy')?.classList.contains('active'));
    }
    function sbSyncView() {
      const chat = document.getElementById('sb-window');
      const bubble = document.getElementById('sb-bubble');
      if (!chat || !bubble) return;
      const full = sbIsFullView();
      const host = full ? document.getElementById('studybuddy-chat-host') : document.body;
      if (chat.parentElement !== host) {
        host.appendChild(chat);
        if (!full) sbOpen = false;
      }
      chat.classList.toggle('sb-full-view', full);
      chat.hidden = sbQuizHidden || (!full && !sbOpen);
      chat.classList.toggle('open', !chat.hidden);
      bubble.hidden = full || sbQuizHidden;
      bubble.classList.toggle('active', sbOpen);
      bubble.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(sbOpen && !chat.hidden));
      document.getElementById('sb-expand-btn').hidden = full;
      document.getElementById('sb-minimize-btn').hidden = !full;
      document.getElementById('sb-close-btn').hidden = full;
      if (full || sbOpen) document.getElementById('sb-unread').hidden = true;
      document.querySelector('.main')?.classList.toggle('studybuddy-expanded', full);
      if (full) sbRenderSubjects();
      sbScrollBottom();
    }
    function sbSetQuizHidden(hidden) {
      sbQuizHidden = hidden;
      if (hidden) sbOpen = false;
      sbSyncView();
    }
    function sbToggle() {
      if (sbQuizHidden) return;
      if (sbIsFullView()) { document.getElementById('sb-input').focus(); return; }
      sbOpen = !sbOpen;
      sbSyncView();
      document.getElementById(sbOpen ? 'sb-input' : 'sb-bubble').focus();
    }
    function sbMinimize() {
      switchTab('home');
      sbOpen = true;
      sbSyncView();
      document.getElementById('sb-input').focus();
    }
    function sbRenderSubjects() {
      const select = document.getElementById('sb-subject-select');
      const subjects = [...new Set([...formalQuizzes, ...informalQuizzes].map(quiz => quiz.subject).filter(Boolean))].sort();
      select.replaceChildren(new Option('Any subject', ''), ...subjects.map(subject => new Option(subject, subject)));
      select.value = subjects.includes(sbCurrentSubject) ? sbCurrentSubject : '';
    }
    function sbSetSubject(subject) {
      sbCurrentSubject = subject || null;
      document.getElementById('sb-input').placeholder = subject ? `Ask about ${subject}...` : 'What would you like to understand?';
      document.getElementById('sb-input').focus();
    }
    function sbPrompt(kind) {
      const topic = sbCurrentSubject || 'a topic I am studying';
      const prompts = {
        explain: `Help me understand a concept in ${topic}. Ask which concept I want to explore first.`,
        practice: `Help me practice ${topic} with one question at a time. Wait for my answer before explaining.`,
        review: `Help me make a review plan for ${topic}. Ask what I need to cover first.`
      };
      document.getElementById('sb-input').value = prompts[kind] || '';
      document.getElementById('sb-input').focus();
    }

        open.append(title, date); open.onclick = () => sbOpenChat(Number(chat.chat_id));

        actions.append(rename, remove); row.append(open, actions); list.append(row);
      }
    }
    async function sbLoadHistory(restore = false) {

      } catch (error) {

    }

    function sbDisplayChat(data) {

      sbHistory = data.messages.map(message => ({role:message.role,content:message.content}));

    function semRows(mysqli $conn, string $sql): array {
        $result = $conn->query($sql);
        if (!$result) throw new Exception($conn->error);
        $rows = [];
        while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) $rows[] = $row;
        $result->free();
        return $rows;
    }
    try {
        $conn = getConnection();
        $metrics = semRows($conn, "SELECT
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student WHERE LOWER(TRIM(status))='active') active_students,
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM instructor WHERE LOWER(TRIM(status))='active') active_instructors,
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quizzes WHERE LOWER(TRIM(status))='active') active_quizzes,
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_idsubmissions WHERE LOWER(TRIM(status)) IN ('submitted','graded')) completed_submissions,
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_idsubmissions WHERE LOWER(TRIM(status)) IN ('submitted','graded') AND score IS NOT NULL) scored_submissions,
          (SELECT ROUND(AVG(score),2) FROM quiz_idsubmissions WHERE LOWER(TRIM(status)) IN ('submitted','graded') AND score IS NOT NULL) average_score,
          (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(xp_earned),0) FROM quiz_idsubmissions WHERE LOWER(TRIM(status)) IN ('submitted','graded')) total_xp,
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flags WHERE status='pending') pending_flags,
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flags WHERE status='resolved') resolved_flags")[0];
        $colleges = semRows($conn, "SELECT s.college,
          COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_id) students,
          COUNT(DISTINCT qs.submission_id) submissions,
          ROUND(AVG(qs.score),2) average_score,
          COALESCE(SUM(qs.xp_earned),0) total_xp
          FROM student s LEFT JOIN quiz_idsubmissions qs ON qs.student_id=s.student_id AND LOWER(TRIM(qs.status)) IN ('submitted','graded')
          WHERE LOWER(TRIM(s.status))='active'
          GROUP BY s.college ORDER BY s.college");
        $students = semRows($conn, "SELECT s.student_id, CONCAT_WS(' ',s.first_name,s.last_name) name, s.college,s.program,s.year_level,s.block,
          COALESCE(SUM(qs.xp_earned),0) xp, ROUND(AVG(qs.score),2) average_score, COUNT(qs.submission_id) submissions
          FROM student s LEFT JOIN quiz_idsubmissions qs ON qs.student_id=s.student_id AND LOWER(TRIM(qs.status)) IN ('submitted','graded')
          WHERE LOWER(TRIM(s.status))='active' GROUP BY s.student_id,s.first_name,s.last_name,s.college,s.program,s.year_level,s.block
          ORDER BY xp DESC, average_score DESC, name ASC LIMIT 10");
        $instructors = semRows($conn, "SELECT i.instructor_id, CONCAT_WS(' ',i.first_name,i.last_name) name,i.college,i.program,i.grade,i.teaching_exp,
          COUNT(DISTINCT q.quiz_id) quizzes_created, COUNT(DISTINCT qs.submission_id) submissions, ROUND(AVG(qs.score),2) average_score
          FROM instructor i LEFT JOIN quizzes q ON q.instructor_id=i.instructor_id
          LEFT JOIN quiz_idsubmissions qs ON qs.quiz_id=q.quiz_id AND LOWER(TRIM(qs.status)) IN ('submitted','graded')
          WHERE LOWER(TRIM(i.status))='active' GROUP BY i.instructor_id,i.first_name,i.last_name,i.college,i.program,i.grade,i.teaching_exp
          ORDER BY i.grade ASC, average_score DESC, quizzes_created DESC, name ASC");
        $flags = semRows($conn, "SELECT f.flag_id,f.quiz_id,q.title quiz_title,f.student_id,CONCAT_WS(' ',s.first_name,s.last_name) student_name,
          f.question_index,f.reason,f.status,f.created_at,f.resolved_at
          FROM flags f LEFT JOIN quizzes q ON q.quiz_id=f.quiz_id LEFT JOIN student s ON s.student_id=f.student_id
          ORDER BY CASE WHEN f.status='pending' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, f.created_at DESC");
        $latest = semRows($conn, "SELECT MAX(dt) latest_activity FROM (

        'https://unpkg.com/docx@8.5.0/build/index.umd.js'

            tryLoadNext();
          }
        };

    function getConnection($withDb = true) {
        $conn = $withDb
            ? new mysqli(DB_HOST, DB_USER, DB_PASS, DB_NAME)
            : new mysqli(DB_HOST, DB_USER, DB_PASS);
    
        if ($conn->connect_error) {
            die("Connection failed: " . $conn->connect_error);
        }
    
        $conn->set_charset('utf8mb4');
        $conn->query("SET time_zone='+08:00'");
        if($withDb){auth_enforce($conn);require_once __DIR__.'/maintenance_service.php';maintenance_enforce($conn);}
        return $conn;
    }

    function auth_enforce(mysqli $db): void {

     if(in_array($endpoint,['get_game_questions.php','game_context.php'],true)&&session_name()==='GABLE_GAME'){$id=(int)($_SESSION['game_tabs'][$_GET['tab']??'']['instructor']??0);$role=$id?'instructor':null;}

     $column=$role.'_id';$sql="SELECT $column".($role==='admin'?'':',status')." FROM $role WHERE $column=?";

    <?php
    require_once __DIR__ . '/config.php';
    header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
    
    try {
        $conn = getConnection();
        $conn->set_charset('utf8mb4');
    
        $students = [];
        $sql = "SELECT s.student_id, s.student_number, s.first_name, s.last_name,
                       TRIM(COALESCE(s.college, '')) AS college,
                       TRIM(COALESCE(s.program, '')) AS program,
                       s.year_level, TRIM(COALESCE(s.block, '')) AS block, s.status,
                       COALESCE(x.xp, 0) AS xp,
                       COALESCE(x.attempts, 0) AS attempts,
                       x.average_score
                FROM student s
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT student_id,
                           SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('submitted','graded') THEN COALESCE(xp_earned,0) ELSE 0 END) AS xp,
                           SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('submitted','graded') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS attempts,
                           AVG(CASE WHEN status IN ('submitted','graded') AND score IS NOT NULL THEN score ELSE NULL END) AS average_score
                    FROM quiz_idsubmissions
                    GROUP BY student_id
                ) x ON x.student_id = s.student_id
                ORDER BY xp DESC, average_score DESC, s.last_name ASC, s.first_name ASC";
        $result = $conn->query($sql);
        if (!$result) throw new Exception($conn->error);
        while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
            $program = trim((string)$row['program']);
            $year = trim((string)($row['year_level'] ?? ''));
            $block = trim((string)$row['block']);
            $row['name'] = trim(($row['first_name'] ?? '') . ' ' . ($row['last_name'] ?? ''));
            $row['section'] = trim($program . ' ' . $year . $block);
            $row['xp'] = (int)$row['xp'];
            $row['attempts'] = (int)$row['attempts'];
            $row['average_score'] = $row['average_score'] === null ? null : (float)$row['average_score'];
            $students[] = $row;
        }
    
        $instructors = [];
        $result = $conn->query("SELECT instructor_id, instructor_number, first_name, last_name,
                                       TRIM(COALESCE(college,'')) AS college,
                                       TRIM(COALESCE(program,'')) AS program,
                                       COALESCE(teaching_exp,0) AS teaching_exp, grade, status
                                FROM instructor
                                ORDER BY teaching_exp DESC, last_name ASC, first_name ASC");
        if (!$result) throw new Exception($conn->error);
        while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
            $row['name'] = trim(($row['first_name'] ?? '') . ' ' . ($row['last_name'] ?? ''));
            $row['teaching_exp'] = (int)$row['teaching_exp'];
            $row['sections'] = [];
            $instructors[(int)$row['instructor_id']] = $row;
        }
    
        // Include sections recorded either in teaching assignments or in quizzes.
        $sectionQueries = [
            "SELECT instructor_id, TRIM(section) AS section FROM teaching_assignments WHERE section IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(section) <> ''",
            "SELECT instructor_id, TRIM(section) AS section FROM quizzes WHERE section IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(section) <> ''"
        ];
        foreach ($sectionQueries as $sectionSql) {
            $result = $conn->query($sectionSql);
            if (!$result) throw new Exception($conn->error);
            while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
                $id = (int)$row['instructor_id'];
                $section = trim((string)$row['section']);
                if ($section !== '' && isset($instructors[$id]) && !in_array($section, $instructors[$id]['sections'], true)) {
                    $instructors[$id]['sections'][] = $section;
                }
            }
        }
        $instructors = array_values($instructors);
        foreach ($instructors as &$instructor) sort($instructor['sections'], SORT_NATURAL | SORT_FLAG_CASE);
        unset($instructor);
    
        // Build the college list from every college recorded for either students or instructors.
        // This keeps colleges visible even when one side has no records or no scored attempts.
        $collegeNames = [];
        $collegeSql = "SELECT college FROM student WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(college,'')) <> ''
                       UNION SELECT college FROM instructor WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(college,'')) <> ''
                       ORDER BY college";
        $result = $conn->query($collegeSql);
        if (!$result) throw new Exception($conn->error);
        while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
            $name = trim((string)($row['college'] ?? ''));
            if ($name !== '') $collegeNames[$name] = true;
        }
    
        $collegeStats = [];
        $statsSql = "SELECT TRIM(COALESCE(s.college,'')) AS college,
                            COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_id) AS students,
                            COUNT(CASE WHEN qs.status IN ('submitted','graded') AND qs.score IS NOT NULL THEN qs.submission_id END) AS scored_attempts,
                            AVG(CASE WHEN qs.status IN ('submitted','graded') AND qs.score IS NOT NULL THEN qs.score ELSE NULL END) AS average_score,
                            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN qs.status IN ('submitted','graded') THEN COALESCE(qs.xp_earned,0) ELSE 0 END),0) AS total_xp
                     FROM student s
                     LEFT JOIN quiz_idsubmissions qs ON qs.student_id = s.student_id
                     WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(s.college,'')) <> ''
                     GROUP BY TRIM(COALESCE(s.college,''))";
        $result = $conn->query($statsSql);
        if (!$result) throw new Exception($conn->error);
        while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) $collegeStats[trim((string)$row['college'])] = $row;
    
        $instructorCounts = [];
        foreach ($instructors as $instructor) {
            $college = trim((string)$instructor['college']);
            if ($college !== '') $instructorCounts[$college] = ($instructorCounts[$college] ?? 0) + 1;
        }
    
        $colleges = [];
        foreach (array_keys($collegeNames) as $collegeName) {
            $stats = $collegeStats[$collegeName] ?? [];
            $average = $stats['average_score'] ?? null;
            $colleges[] = [
                'college' => $collegeName,
                'students' => (int)($stats['students'] ?? 0),
                'instructors' => (int)($instructorCounts[$collegeName] ?? 0),
                'scored_attempts' => (int)($stats['scored_attempts'] ?? 0),
                'average_score' => $average === null ? null : (float)$average,
                'total_xp' => (int)($stats['total_xp'] ?? 0)
            ];
        }
        usort($colleges, function ($a, $b) {
            if ($a['average_score'] === null && $b['average_score'] !== null) return 1;
            if ($a['average_score'] !== null && $b['average_score'] === null) return -1;
            return (($b['average_score'] ?? -1) <=> ($a['average_score'] ?? -1))
                ?: ($b['students'] <=> $a['students'])
                ?: strcasecmp($a['college'], $b['college']);
        });
    
        echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'students' => $students, 'instructors' => $instructors, 'colleges' => $colleges], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        $conn->close();
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        http_response_code(500);
        echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Failed to load leaderboard data.', 'error' => $e->getMessage()], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
    }

## Assistant

I found that XP is currently recalculated from all historical quiz submissions, so simply setting balances to zero would not work.

I’m adding a semester boundary while preserving quiz scores and past awards. The admin flow will archive and export rankings first, then allow a deliberate reset. Six months will be the scheduled duration, with the reset controlled by the admin rather than running automatically.

    <?php
    require_once __DIR__.'/powerup_service.php';
    
    function semester_current(mysqli $db): array {
        return pu_row($db,'SELECT * FROM current_xp_semester');
    }
    
    function semester_snapshot(mysqli $db): array {
        $students=pu_query($db,"SELECT s.student_id,s.student_number,CONCAT_WS(' ',s.first_name,s.last_name) name,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.college),''),'Unspecified college') college,s.program,s.year_level,s.block,s.status,
            x.earned_xp,x.bonus_xp,x.spent_xp,x.semester_xp,x.xp,
            COALESCE(p.lifetime_xp,0) level_progress,COALESCE(p.streak,0) streak,p.last_activity
            FROM student s JOIN current_student_xp x ON x.student_id=s.student_id
            LEFT JOIN student_reward_progress p ON p.student_id=s.student_id
            ORDER BY x.semester_xp DESC,s.last_name,s.first_name,s.student_id")->get_result()->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
        $grants=pu_query($db,'SELECT * FROM student_powerup_grants ORDER BY student_id,level')->get_result()->fetch_all(MYSQLI_ASSOC);
        $cutoffs=pu_row($db,'SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(submission_id),0) FROM quiz_idsubmissions) submission_cutoff,
            (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(redemption_id),0) FROM grade_boost_redemptions) redemption_cutoff,
            (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(use_id),0) FROM student_powerup_uses) use_cutoff');
        return ['semester'=>semester_current($db),'students'=>$students,'grants'=>$grants,'cutoffs'=>$cutoffs];
    }
    
    function semester_hash(array $snapshot): string {
        return hash('sha256',json_encode($snapshot,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
    }
    
    function semester_lock_students(mysqli $db): void {
        // Every XP mutation locks its student's row; hold the same locks for an atomic rollover.
        pu_query($db,'SELECT student_id FROM student ORDER BY student_id FOR UPDATE')->get_result()->fetch_all();
        pu_query($db,'SELECT semester_id FROM student_xp_semesters ORDER BY semester_id FOR UPDATE')->get_result()->fetch_all();
    }
    
    function semester_reset(mysqli $db,int $exportId,int $admin,string $label): void {
        $label=trim($label);
        if ($label==='' || mb_strlen($label)>100) throw new RuntimeException('Enter a semester name of 1–100 characters.',422);
        $export=pu_row($db,'SELECT * FROM student_xp_exports WHERE export_id=? AND admin_id=? FOR UPDATE',[$exportId,$admin]);
        if (!$export || $export['used_at']) throw new RuntimeException('Download a fresh semester export before resetting.',409);
        $snapshot=semester_snapshot($db);
        if ((int)$export['semester_id']!==(int)$snapshot['semester']['semester_id'] || !hash_equals($export['snapshot_hash'],semester_hash($snapshot))) {
            throw new RuntimeException('XP or student records changed after export. Download a fresh export before resetting.',409);
        }
        $active=pu_row($db,'SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM student_quiz_attempts a LEFT JOIN quiz_idsubmissions q ON q.student_id=a.student_id AND q.quiz_id=a.quiz_id WHERE q.submission_id IS NULL AND a.deadline>UNIX_TIMESTAMP()');
        if ((int)$active['n']>0) throw new RuntimeException('Students have active quiz attempts. Wait for them to finish, then export again.',409);
        $bounds=$snapshot['cutoffs'];
        pu_query($db,'UPDATE student_xp_semesters SET closed_at=NOW(),closed_by=? WHERE semester_id=?',[$admin,$export['semester_id']]);
        pu_query($db,'INSERT INTO student_xp_semesters(label,scheduled_end,submission_cutoff,redemption_cutoff,use_cutoff,opened_by) VALUES (?,DATE_ADD(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 6 MONTH),?,?,?,?)',[$label,$bounds['submission_cutoff'],$bounds['redemption_cutoff'],$bounds['use_cutoff'],$admin]);
        pu_query($db,'DELETE FROM student_powerup_grants');
        pu_query($db,'DELETE FROM student_reward_progress');
        pu_query($db,'UPDATE student_xp_exports SET used_at=NOW() WHERE export_id=?',[$exportId]);
    }

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_xp_semesters (
     semester_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
     label VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
     started_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
     scheduled_end DATE NOT NULL,
     closed_at DATETIME NULL,
     submission_cutoff INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
     redemption_cutoff INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
     use_cutoff INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
     opened_by INT NULL,
     closed_by INT NULL
    ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
    INSERT INTO student_xp_semesters(label,scheduled_end)
    SELECT 'Initial semester (includes existing XP)', DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM student_xp_semesters);
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_xp_exports (
     export_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
     semester_id INT NOT NULL,
     admin_id INT NOT NULL,
     created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
     snapshot_json LONGTEXT NOT NULL,
     snapshot_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
     used_at DATETIME NULL,
     KEY semester_exports(semester_id)
    ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
    CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW current_xp_semester AS
    SELECT * FROM student_xp_semesters WHERE semester_id=(SELECT MAX(semester_id) FROM student_xp_semesters);
    CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW current_student_xp AS
    SELECT s.student_id,
     COALESCE(q.earned_xp,0) earned_xp,
     COALESCE(g.bonus_xp,0) bonus_xp,
     COALESCE(r.spent_xp,0)+COALESCE(u.spent_xp,0) spent_xp,
     COALESCE(q.earned_xp,0)+COALESCE(g.bonus_xp,0) semester_xp,
     GREATEST(0,COALESCE(q.earned_xp,0)+COALESCE(g.bonus_xp,0)-COALESCE(r.spent_xp,0)-COALESCE(u.spent_xp,0)) xp
    FROM student s
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT student_id,SUM(xp_earned) earned_xp FROM quiz_idsubmissions
     WHERE submission_id>(SELECT submission_cutoff FROM current_xp_semester) AND status IN ('submitted','graded') GROUP BY student_id) q ON q.student_id=s.student_id
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT student_id,SUM(bonus) bonus_xp FROM student_powerup_grants GROUP BY student_id) g ON g.student_id=s.student_id
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT student_id,SUM(xp_cost) spent_xp FROM grade_boost_redemptions
     WHERE redemption_id>(SELECT redemption_cutoff FROM current_xp_semester) GROUP BY student_id) r ON r.student_id=s.student_id
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT student_id,SUM(xp_cost) spent_xp FROM student_powerup_uses
     WHERE use_id>(SELECT use_cutoff FROM current_xp_semester) GROUP BY student_id) u ON u.student_id=s.student_id;

    let studentSemesterCsrf = '';
    let studentSemesterExport = null;
    
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const host = document.getElementById('settings-controls');
      if (!host) return;
      const card = document.createElement('article');
      card.className = 'configuration-card semester-control';
      card.innerHTML = `<header><span class="admin-eyebrow">STUDENT XP · SIX-MONTH SEMESTERS</span><h3>Close a semester and restart student XP</h3></header>
        <p id="student-semester-current" role="status">Loading current semester…</p>
        <p>Each semester has its own XP, levels, frames, unused power-ups and streaks. Closing it restarts these for <strong>all students</strong>. Quiz scores, historical awards and instructor XP stay unchanged. The scheduled end is a reminder; resets never run automatically.</p>
        <div class="semester-steps"><section><h4>1. Export and save the results</h4><p>Download a formatted report with the university top 10, top 10 per college and every student’s XP balance. Open the HTML file in a browser to read it offline or print to PDF.</p><button type="button" class="btn-secondary" id="student-semester-export">Export semester results</button></section>
        <section><h4>2. Start the next semester</h4><p>Only continue after saving the export. If balances change, a fresh export is required. Active quiz attempts must finish first.</p>
        <label for="student-semester-label">Next semester name</label><input id="student-semester-label" maxlength="100" placeholder="e.g. AY 2026–2027 · Second semester" autocomplete="off">
        <label class="semester-check"><input id="student-semester-saved" type="checkbox"> I saved the exported report and understand all student progression will restart.</label>
        <label for="student-semester-confirm">Type RESET STUDENT XP</label><input id="student-semester-confirm" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
        <button type="button" class="btn-primary" id="student-semester-reset" disabled>Reset students &amp; start next semester</button></section></div>
        <p id="student-semester-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
        <details><summary>Saved semester exports</summary><div id="student-semester-history"></div></details>`;
      host.append(card);
      document.getElementById('student-semester-export').onclick = studentSemesterDownload;
      document.getElementById('student-semester-reset').onclick = studentSemesterReset;
      for (const id of ['student-semester-label','student-semester-saved','student-semester-confirm']) document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('input', studentSemesterReady);
      studentSemesterLoad().catch(error => studentSemesterStatus(error.message));
    });
    
    function studentSemesterStatus(text) { document.getElementById('student-semester-status').textContent = text; }
    function studentSemesterReady() {
      document.getElementById('student-semester-reset').disabled = !studentSemesterExport || !document.getElementById('student-semester-label').value.trim() || !document.getElementById('student-semester-saved').checked || document.getElementById('student-semester-confirm').value !== 'RESET STUDENT XP';
    }
    async function studentSemesterApi(body) {
      const response = await fetch('../assets/php/admin_student_semester.php', {
        credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store',
        ...(body ? {method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({...body,csrf:studentSemesterCsrf})} : {})
      });
      const data = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok || !data.success) throw new Error(data.message || 'Semester action failed.');
      return data;
    }
    async function studentSemesterLoad() {
      const data = await studentSemesterApi();
      studentSemesterCsrf = data.csrf;
      document.getElementById('student-semester-current').textContent = `${data.semester.label} · Started ${data.semester.started_at} · Scheduled end ${data.semester.scheduled_end}`;
      const history = document.getElementById('student-semester-history'); history.replaceChildren();
      for (const item of data.exports) {
        const link = document.createElement('a');
        link.href = `../assets/php/admin_student_semester.php?download=${Number(item.export_id)}`;
        link.textContent = `Export #${item.export_id} · ${item.created_at}${item.used_at ? ' · Semester closed' : ' · Snapshot'}`;
        history.append(link);
      }
      if (!data.exports.length) history.textContent = 'No exports yet.';
    }
    async function studentSemesterDownload() {
      const button = document.getElementById('student-semester-export'); button.disabled = true;
      studentSemesterExport = null; studentSemesterReady();
      studentSemesterStatus('Archiving student XP and preparing the report…');
      try {
        const data = await studentSemesterApi({action:'export'});
        const response = await fetch(`../assets/php/admin_student_semester.php?download=${data.export_id}`, {credentials:'same-origin',cache:'no-store'});
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Download failed. Please try exporting again.');
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(await response.blob());
        const link = document.createElement('a'); link.href = url; link.download = `GABLE_Semester_XP_${data.export_id}.html`;
        document.body.append(link); link.click(); link.remove(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url),30000);
        studentSemesterExport = data.export_id;
        document.getElementById('student-semester-saved').checked = false;
        studentSemesterStatus('Report prepared and download requested. Open your saved file and verify it before confirming the reset.');
        await studentSemesterLoad();
      } catch (error) { studentSemesterStatus(error.message); }
      finally { button.disabled = false; studentSemesterReady(); }
    }
    async function studentSemesterReset() {
      const button = document.getElementById('student-semester-reset'); button.disabled = true;
      document.getElementById('student-semester-export').disabled = true;
      try {
        await studentSemesterApi({action:'reset',export_id:studentSemesterExport,label:document.getElementById('student-semester-label').value.trim(),confirmation:document.getElementById('student-semester-confirm').value,saved_export:document.getElementById('student-semester-saved').checked});
        studentSemesterExport = null;
        document.getElementById('student-semester-confirm').value = '';
        document.getElementById('student-semester-saved').checked = false;
        studentSemesterStatus('New semester started. All student XP, levels, frames, power-ups and streaks restarted. Previous results are archived. Refresh other open tabs to see the new balances.');
        await studentSemesterLoad();
      } catch (error) { studentSemesterExport = null; studentSemesterStatus(error.message + ' Export again before retrying.'); }
      finally { document.getElementById('student-semester-export').disabled = false; studentSemesterReady(); }
    }

        if (!$result) throw new Exception($conn->error);
        $rows = [];

        $result->free();

    const _revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(e => {
        if (e.isIntersecting) {
          e.target.classList.add('visible');
          _revealObserver.unobserve(e.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12 });
    
    document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => _revealObserver.observe(el));

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          document.body.classList.add('page-enter-active', 'ready');
        });
      });
    
      document.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
        const href = link.getAttribute('href');
    
        if (
          !href ||
          href === '#' ||
          href.startsWith('http') ||
          href.startsWith('mailto') ||
          href.startsWith('tel')
        ) return;
    
        link.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();
    
          const target = this.getAttribute('href');
    
          document.body.style.opacity = '0';
          document.body.style.transition = 'opacity .3s';
          document.body.classList.add('page-exit');
    
          setTimeout(() => {
            window.location.href = target;
          }, 320);
        });
      });
    
      document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay').forEach(overlay => {
        overlay.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          if (e.target === this) {
            closeModal(this.id);
          }
        });
      });
    
    });

    +## Student XP semesters
    +
    +Student XP progression belongs to a six-month semester. Spending reduces available XP but does not lower the student's level within the semester. The scheduled end is a reminder; only an administrator can close the period.
    +
    +In **Admin → Settings → Platform & rewards**, use **Close a semester and restart student XP**:
    +
    +1. Export and save the HTML report. It includes the university top 10, the top 10 per recorded college, and the complete student XP register. Open it offline or use your browser's Print → Save as PDF. Ranking uses earned semester XP including bonuses before spending; ties use last name, first name, then student ID. All student accounts are included.
    +2. Enter the next semester name, confirm that the report is saved, and type `RESET STUDENT XP`.
    +3. Start the next semester. Changed student records require a fresh export. Active quiz attempts must finish first. Saved exports remain available in admin history.
    +
    +Reset restarts all student XP, levels, frames, unused power-ups and streaks. Quiz grades, historical awards and instructor XP remain intact. Earlier submissions cannot earn XP or consume rewards in the new semester, even when graded later. Grade boosts apply only to current-semester submissions. Students can earn level rewards again in the new semester. Refresh open student pages after reset.
    +
    +The initial period includes existing XP because older records have no semester assignment. The first reset establishes a clean boundary. The legacy database field `student_reward_progress.lifetime_xp` now stores only current-semester progression and is cleared on reset.
    +
    +Run `C:\xampp\php\php.exe tools\test_student_semester.php` to validate the export and reset. This test creates and drops a separate, uniquely named database; it never resets application accounts.
    +
     GABLE (Game Based Learning Environment) is a web application for managing quizzes and coursework with game-inspired progression. Students take quizzes and earn XP, instructors manage classes and review outcomes, and administrators manage the platform.

    # GABLE
    
    ## Student XP semesters
    
    Student XP progression belongs to a six-month semester. Spending reduces available XP but does not lower the student's level within the semester. The scheduled end is a reminder; only an administrator can close the period.
    
    In **Admin â†’ Settings â†’ Platform & rewards**, use **Close a semester and restart student XP**:
    
    1. Export and save the HTML report. It includes the university top 10, the top 10 per recorded college, and the complete student XP register. Open it offline or use your browser's Print â†’ Save as PDF. Ranking uses earned semester XP including bonuses before spending; ties use last name, first name, then student ID. All student accounts are included.
    2. Enter the next semester name, confirm that the report is saved, and type `RESET STUDENT XP`.
    3. Start the next semester. Changed student records require a fresh export. Active quiz attempts must finish first. Saved exports remain available in admin history.
    
    Reset restarts all student XP, levels, frames, unused power-ups and streaks. Quiz grades, historical awards and instructor XP remain intact. Earlier submissions cannot earn XP or consume rewards in the new semester, even when graded later. Grade boosts apply only to current-semester submissions. Students can earn level rewards again in the new semester. Refresh open student pages after reset.
    
    The initial period includes existing XP because older records have no semester assignment. The first reset establishes a clean boundary. The legacy database field `student_reward_progress.lifetime_xp` now stores only current-semester progression and is cleared on reset.
    
    Run `C:\xampp\php\php.exe tools\test_student_semester.php` to validate the export and reset. This test creates and drops a separate, uniquely named database; it never resets application accounts.
    
    GABLE (Game Based Learning Environment) is a web application for managing quizzes and coursework with game-inspired progression. Students take quizzes and earn XP, instructors manage classes and review outcomes, and administrators manage the platform.
    
    ## Roles and portals
    
    - **Student** - take formal and informal quizzes, review results, use learning tools, earn XP, and view rankings. Main pages: `pages/Student.html`, `pages/Sdashboard.html`, and `pages/Game.html`.
    - **Instructor** - manage quizzes and classes, review submissions and syllabus alignment, and view teaching XP and rank. Main pages: `pages/Instructor.html` and `pages/Idashboard.html`.
    - **Administrator** - manage users, quizzes, settings, reports, announcements, and instructor evaluations. Main page: `pages/Admin.html`.
    - **Public pages** - `pages/Index.html`, `pages/Features.html`, `pages/About.html`, `pages/Help.html`, and `pages/Login.html`.
    
    ## Technology
    
    - PHP 8+ backend with MySQLi and MySQL/MariaDB
    - HTML, CSS, and browser JavaScript; there is no Node build step or Composer dependency manager
    - Apache for local hosting (for example, XAMPP)
    - Groq API for AI-assisted features such as study support and content reviews

    function getStudentSubjects() {
    
        const subjects = [];
    
    
        databaseQuizzes
            .filter(
                quiz =>
                    quizMatchesStudent(quiz)
            )
            .filter(
                quiz =>
                    String(
                        quiz.status || 'active'
                    ).toLowerCase() === 'active'
            )
            .forEach(
                quiz => {
    
                    const subject =
                        String(
                            quiz.subject || ''
                        ).trim();
    
    
                    if (
                        subject &&
                        !subjects.some(
                            existing =>
                                existing.toLowerCase() ===
                                subject.toLowerCase()
                        )
                    ) {
    
                        subjects.push(
                            subject
                        );
    
                    }
    
                }
            );
    
    
        return subjects.sort(
            (a, b) =>
                a.localeCompare(b)
        );
    
    }
    
    function renderSubjectSelector() {
    
        const container =
            document.getElementById(
                'lb-subject-selector'
            );
    
    
        if (!container) {
            return;
        }
    
    
        const subjects =
            getStudentSubjects();
    
    
        if (!subjects.length) {
    
            container.innerHTML = `

                        font-size:.85rem;
                    "
                >
                    ðŸ“š No subjects available yet.
                </div>
    
            `;
    
            return;
    
        }

    function renderStudentSubjects(subjects) {
      const host = document.getElementById('student-subjects-list');
      if (!host) return;
      host.replaceChildren();
      if (!subjects.length) {
        const empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'metric-caption';
        empty.textContent = 'No subjects assigned to your section yet.';
        host.append(empty);
        return;
      }
      const grouped = new Map();
      for (const item of subjects) {
        if (!grouped.has(item.subject)) grouped.set(item.subject, new Set());
        grouped.get(item.subject).add(item.instructor);
      }
      for (const [subject, instructors] of grouped) {
        const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'student-subject-row';
        const title = document.createElement('strong'); title.textContent = subject;
        const teacher = document.createElement('span'); teacher.textContent = `Instructor: ${[...instructors].join(', ')}`;
        row.append(title, teacher); host.append(row);
      }
    }

        $stmt=$conn->prepare('SELECT student_id,student_number,college,program,year_level,block FROM student WHERE student_id=?');
        $stmt->bind_param('i',$studentId);$stmt->execute();$current=$stmt->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
        if (!$current) throw new RuntimeException('Student not found.');
        $college=trim((string)$current['college']);
        // Aggregate once, instead of recalculating the complete XP view for every student.
        $sql="SELECT s.student_id,s.student_number,s.first_name,s.last_name,s.program,s.year_level,s.block,
            COALESCE(q.earned,0)+COALESCE(g.bonus,0) total_xp,
            COALESCE(q.avg_score,0) avg_score,COALESCE(q.attempts,0) submissions_count
            FROM student s
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT qs.student_id,SUM(qs.xp_earned) earned,AVG(qs.score) avg_score,COUNT(*) attempts
                FROM quiz_idsubmissions qs JOIN quizzes quiz ON quiz.quiz_id=qs.quiz_id
                WHERE qs.submission_id>(SELECT submission_cutoff FROM current_xp_semester)
                  AND qs.status IN ('submitted','graded')";
        if ($subject!=='') $sql.=" AND LOWER(TRIM(quiz.subject))=LOWER(TRIM(?))";
        $sql.=" GROUP BY qs.student_id
            ) q ON q.student_id=s.student_id
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT student_id,SUM(bonus) bonus FROM student_powerup_grants GROUP BY student_id) g ON g.student_id=s.student_id
            WHERE TRIM(s.college)=? AND ?<>''";
        if ($subject!=='') $sql.=" AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM (
                SELECT section,subject_name subject FROM teaching_assignments
                UNION SELECT section,subject FROM quizzes WHERE status='active'
            ) enrollment
            WHERE LOWER(TRIM(enrollment.section)) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci=LOWER(TRIM(CONCAT(s.program,' ',s.year_level,s.block))) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
              AND LOWER(TRIM(enrollment.subject))=LOWER(TRIM(?))
        )";
        $sql.=' ORDER BY total_xp DESC,s.last_name,s.first_name,s.student_id';
        $stmt=$conn->prepare($sql);
        if ($subject==='') $stmt->bind_param('ss',$college,$college);
        else $stmt->bind_param('ssss',$subject,$college,$college,$subject);
        $stmt->execute();$students=[];
        foreach($stmt->get_result() as $row) {
            $students[]=['id'=>(string)$row['student_number'],'student_id'=>(int)$row['student_id'],
                'name'=>trim($row['first_name'].' '.$row['last_name']), 'program'=>$row['program'],
                'year_level'=>(int)$row['year_level'],'block'=>$row['block'],
                'section'=>trim($row['program'].' '.$row['year_level'].$row['block']),
                'xp'=>(int)$row['total_xp'],'score'=>round((float)$row['avg_score'],2),'submissions'=>(int)$row['submissions_count']];
        }
        echo json_encode(['success'=>true,'scope'=>'college','college'=>$college,'student'=>[
            'id'=>(int)$current['student_id'],'student_number'=>$current['student_number'],'college'=>$college,
            'program'=>$current['program'],'year_level'=>(int)$current['year_level'],'block'=>$current['block'],
            'section'=>trim($current['program'].' '.$current['year_level'].$current['block'])
        ],'students'=>$students],JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);

            const list = document.getElementById('lb-list');
            if (!list) return;
            const version = ++lbRenderVersion;
            let data = [...leaderboardData];
            if (filter === 'subject') {
                if (!lbSelectedSubject) { list.textContent = 'Please select a subject.'; return; }
                list.textContent = 'Loading subject rankings...';
                try {
                    const response = await fetch('../assets/php/get_student_leaderboard.php?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(lbSelectedSubject), {credentials:'include',cache:'no-store'});
                    const result = await response.json();
                    if (version !== lbRenderVersion) return;
                    if (!response.ok || !result.success) throw new Error(result.message || 'Could not load rankings.');
                    data = result.students.map(student => ({...student, isMe:String(student.id) === String(studentProfile?.id)}));
                } catch (error) {
                    if (version === lbRenderVersion) list.textContent = error.message;
                    return;
                }
            } else if (filter === 'section') {
                const normalize = value => String(value || '').toLowerCase().replace(/\\s+/g, '');
                data = data.filter(student => normalize(student.section) === normalize(studentProfile?.section));
            }
            list.replaceChildren();
            if (!data.length) { list.textContent = 'No students found for this leaderboard.'; return; }
            const total = data.length;
            const myRank = data.findIndex(student => student.isMe) + 1;
            const pages = Math.ceil(total / 50);
            page = Math.max(1, Math.min(page, pages));
            const offset = (page - 1) * 50;
            const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
            data.slice(offset, offset + 50).forEach((student, index) => {
                const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'lb-row' + (student.isMe ? ' me' : '');
                const rank = document.createElement('div'); rank.className = 'lb-rank'; rank.textContent = '#' + (offset + index + 1);
                const avatar = document.createElement('div'); avatar.className = 'lb-avatar';
                avatar.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg,#4f8ef7,#7c5cbf)'; avatar.textContent = initialsFromName(student.name || student.id);
                const info = document.createElement('div'); info.className = 'lb-info';
                const name = document.createElement('strong'); name.textContent = student.name + (student.isMe ? ' (You)' : '');
                const section = document.createElement('span'); section.textContent = 'Section ' + student.section;
                info.append(name, section);
                const xp = document.createElement('div'); xp.className = 'lb-xp'; xp.textContent = Number(student.xp || 0).toLocaleString() + ' XP';
                const score = document.createElement('div'); score.className = 'lb-score'; score.textContent = Number(student.score || 0).toFixed(2) + '%';
                row.append(rank, avatar, info, xp, score); fragment.append(row);
            });
            const navigation = document.createElement('div'); navigation.className = 'lb-pagination';
            const summary = document.createElement('span');
            summary.textContent = `${offset + 1}-${Math.min(offset + 50, total)} of ${total} students${myRank ? ` | Your rank: #${myRank}` : ''}`;
            navigation.append(summary);
            if (pages > 1) {
                for (const [label, target] of [['Previous', page - 1], ['Next', page + 1]]) {
                    const button = document.createElement('button'); button.type = 'button'; button.className = 'btn-secondary';
                    button.textContent = label; button.disabled = target < 1 || target > pages;
                    button.onclick = () => renderLeaderboard(filter, target); navigation.append(button);
                }
            }
            fragment.append(navigation); list.append(fragment);
        }

    ## Local setup
    
    1. Place the project under the Apache document root. With the default XAMPP layout, open `http://localhost/GABLE/pages/Index.html`.
    2. Create a private PHP config file outside the web root. `assets/php/config.php` loads the path in the `GABLE_PRIVATE_CONFIG` environment variable; if unset, it looks for `C:\xampp\gable-private\config.php` in the default XAMPP layout. The private file must define `DB_HOST`, `DB_USER`, `DB_PASS`, `DB_NAME`, and `GROQ_API_KEY`.
    3. Ensure PHP has the `mysqli` extension enabled and can connect to the configured MySQL/MariaDB server. The configured database user needs permission to create the configured database and tables for the migration runner.
    4. Run the schema migrations from the project root:
    
       ```powershell
       C:\xampp\php\php.exe tools\migrate.php
       ```
    
       This creates the database if needed, applies the baseline and any unapplied migrations in `assets/sql/`, and records them in `schema_migrations`. If you import `full_system.sql` instead, run the migration command afterward to apply newer changes, including semester XP. The snapshot contains schema, not application records.
    
    5. Create an administrator with the CLI tool `tools/create_admin.php`. It reads a JSON object from standard input with `admin_number`, `first_name`, `last_name`, and `password` fields. Use a unique administrator number and a password 8 to 72 bytes long.
    6. Sign in through `pages/Login.html` and choose the account role.
    
    AI features that call Groq require a valid API key. Keep database credentials and API keys in the private config or environment, never in public pages or committed files. Some announcement drafting code also supports `assets/php/config.local.php` for a separate key; see `assets/php/config.local.php.example` for that feature's setup notes.
    
    ## Background quiz finalization
    
    `tools/finalize_quizzes.php` finalizes eligible expired quiz attempts and processes instructor quiz rewards. It can preview eligible attempts without making changes:
    
    ```powershell
    C:\xampp\php\php.exe tools\finalize_quizzes.php --dry-run
    ```
    
    Run without `--dry-run` to process them. The utility is CLI-only; it is not a web page.
    
    ## Notes
    
    - PHP endpoints are under `assets/php/`; browser pages call them with session-based role checks.
    - SQL migration files and the complete SQL snapshot are blocked from direct web access by `.htaccess`.

    // Call mutations inside a transaction after locking the student's row.
    function pu_query(mysqli $db, string $sql, array $params = []): mysqli_stmt {
        $stmt = $db->prepare($sql);
        if ($params) $stmt->bind_param(str_repeat('s', count($params)), ...$params);
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt;
    }
    function pu_row(mysqli $db, string $sql, array $params = []): ?array {
        return pu_query($db, $sql, $params)->get_result()->fetch_assoc();
    }
    function pu_lock(mysqli $db, int $student): void {
        if (!pu_row($db, 'SELECT student_id FROM student WHERE student_id=? AND status=? FOR UPDATE', [$student, 'Active'])) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Student account unavailable.', 403);
        }
    }

    }
    function pu_sync(mysqli $db, int $student): array {
        pu_query($db, 'INSERT IGNORE INTO student_reward_progress(student_id) VALUES (?)', [$student]);
        $balance = pu_balance($db,$student);
        $progress = pu_row($db, 'SELECT * FROM student_reward_progress WHERE student_id=?', [$student]);

    }

The leaderboard will use each student’s semester level to show the same frame they have on their profile. The top five will have gold, silver, bronze, purple, and teal highlights.

The `.bat` command will reuse the 21-program catalog and sequential password format. It will save login details outside the website folder so they aren’t committed to GitHub.

    <?php
    if (PHP_SAPI!=='cli') { http_response_code(404); exit; }
    require_once __DIR__.'/../assets/php/config.php';
    require_once __DIR__.'/../assets/php/powerup_service.php';
    
    function seed_demo_accounts(mysqli $db,array $catalog,string $directory): array {
        $expectedTeachers=count($catalog)*5; $expectedStudents=count($catalog)*130;
        if (!$catalog) throw new RuntimeException('The program catalog is empty.');
        foreach ($catalog as $entry) {
            if (empty($entry['college']) || empty($entry['program']) || count(array_unique($entry['subjects']??[]))!==6) throw new RuntimeException('Each program needs a college and six distinct subjects.');
        }
        $lock=pu_row($db,"SELECT GET_LOCK(CONCAT(DATABASE(),':gable_demo_seed'),0) acquired");
        if ((int)$lock['acquired']!==1) throw new RuntimeException('Another account setup is running.');
        $file=null;$pending=null;
        try {
            $teachers=(int)pu_row($db,"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM instructor WHERE institutional_email LIKE '%@demo.gable.test'")['n'];
            $students=(int)pu_row($db,"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM student WHERE institutional_email LIKE '%@demo.gable.test'")['n'];
            if ($teachers===$expectedTeachers && $students===$expectedStudents) {
                return ['status'=>'Already present; no accounts or passwords changed.','instructors'=>$teachers,'students'=>$students,'account_lists'=>$directory];
            }
            if ($teachers || $students) throw new RuntimeException('A partial demo batch already exists. Setup stopped to preserve it; no duplicate accounts were created.');
            if (!is_dir($directory) && !mkdir($directory,0700,true)) throw new RuntimeException('Could not create the private account-list directory.');
            $path=$directory.'/demo-accounts-'.date('Ymd-His').'-'.bin2hex(random_bytes(3)).'.csv';
            $pending=$path.'.pending';$file=fopen($pending,'x');
            if (!$file) throw new RuntimeException('Could not create the private account list.');
            if(fputcsv($file,['Role','Login ID','Name','College','Program','Section','Subjects','Initial XP','Password'],',','"','')===false) throw new RuntimeException('Could not write account list.');
            $first=['Adrian','Bianca','Carlo','Diana','Ethan','Faith','Gabriel','Hannah','Isaac','Julia','Kyle','Lara','Miguel','Nina','Oscar','Paula','Rafael','Sofia','Tristan','Valerie','Wesley','Yasmin','Zachary','Andrea','Brandon','Camille','Daniel','Elena','Felix','Grace'];
            $last=['Santos','Reyes','Cruz','Garcia','Mendoza','Torres','Ramos','Flores','Rivera','Gonzales','Lopez','Castillo','Aquino','Bautista','Villanueva','Fernandez','Navarro','Morales','Perez','Santiago','Lim','Tan','Soriano','Valdez','Aguilar','Domingo','Mercado','Salazar','Francisco','Tolentino'];
            $password=12345;$created=0;
            $db->begin_transaction();
            // Lock existing account ranges while allocating the next role-specific login numbers.
            pu_query($db,'SELECT student_id FROM student ORDER BY student_id FOR UPDATE')->get_result()->fetch_all();
            pu_query($db,'SELECT instructor_id FROM instructor ORDER BY instructor_id FOR UPDATE')->get_result()->fetch_all();
            $year=(int)date('Y')*10000;
            $nextStudent=max($year+1000,(int)pu_row($db,'SELECT MAX(student_number) n FROM student')['n'])+1;
            $nextTeacher=max($year+2000,(int)pu_row($db,'SELECT MAX(instructor_number) n FROM instructor')['n'])+1;
            foreach ($catalog as $p=>$entry) {
                $college=$entry['college'];$program=$entry['program'];$subjects=$entry['subjects'];shuffle($subjects);
                $teacherIds=[];$loads=[];$owners=[];
                for($i=0;$i<5;$i++) {
                    $number=$nextTeacher++;$name=$first[array_rand($first)];$surname=$last[array_rand($last)];$xp=random_int(0,10000);
                    $plain=(string)$password++;$hash=password_hash($plain,PASSWORD_BCRYPT,['cost'=>10]);
                    pu_query($db,"INSERT INTO instructor(instructor_number,institutional_email,first_name,last_name,college,program,password,teaching_exp,status) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'Active')",[$number,'i'.(910000000+$p*10+$i).'@demo.gable.test',$name,$surname,$college,$program,$hash,$xp]);
                    $id=$db->insert_id;$teacherIds[]=$id;
                    $picked=[$subjects[($i*2)%6],$subjects[($i*2+1)%6]];
                    if(random_int(0,1)){ $extra=array_values(array_diff($subjects,$picked));$picked[]=$extra[array_rand($extra)]; }
                    $loads[$id]=$picked;foreach($picked as $subject)$owners[$subject][]=$id;
                    if(fputcsv($file,['instructor',$number,$name.' '.$surname,$college,$program,'',implode(' | ',$picked),$xp,$plain],',','"','')===false)throw new RuntimeException('Account list write failed.');
                    $created++;
                }
                foreach(range('A','Z') as $s=>$block) {
                    $section=$program.' 1'.$block;
                    if($s<5)$picked=$loads[$teacherIds[$s]];
                    else{$picked=$subjects;shuffle($picked);$picked=array_slice($picked,0,random_int(2,3));}
                    foreach($picked as $subject){
                        $teacher=$s<5?$teacherIds[$s]:$owners[$subject][array_rand($owners[$subject])];
                        pu_query($db,"INSERT INTO teaching_assignments(instructor_id,subject_name,section,assignment_type) VALUES (?,?,?,'Lecture')",[$teacher,$subject,$section]);
                    }
                    for($i=0;$i<5;$i++) {
                        $number=$nextStudent++;$name=$first[array_rand($first)].' '.chr(random_int(65,90)).'.';$surname=$last[array_rand($last)];
                        $plain=(string)$password++;$hash=password_hash($plain,PASSWORD_BCRYPT,['cost'=>10]);
                        pu_query($db,"INSERT INTO student(student_number,institutional_email,first_name,last_name,college,program,year_level,block,password,status) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,1,?,?,'Active')",[$number,'s'.(920000000+$p*1000+$s*5+$i).'@demo.gable.test',$name,$surname,$college,$program,$block,$hash]);
                        $id=$db->insert_id;$xp=random_int(0,8500);
                        pu_query($db,"INSERT INTO student_powerup_grants(student_id,level,type,remaining,permanent,bonus) VALUES (?,0,'semester_demo',0,0,?)",[$id,$xp]);
                        $state=pu_sync($db,$id);
                        if(fputcsv($file,['student',$number,$name.' '.$surname,$college,$program,$section,implode(' | ',$picked),$state['xp'],$plain],',','"','')===false)throw new RuntimeException('Account list write failed.');
                        $created++;
                    }
                }
                echo 'Prepared '.$program.' ('.$created.' accounts).'.PHP_EOL;
            }
            if(!fflush($file))throw new RuntimeException('Could not save account list.');
            fclose($file);$file=null;
            if(!rename($pending,$path))throw new RuntimeException('Could not finalize account list.');
            $pending=$path;
            $db->commit();$pending=null;
            return ['status'=>'Created','instructors'=>$expectedTeachers,'students'=>$expectedStudents,'subjects'=>count($catalog)*6,'sections'=>count($catalog)*26,'password_range'=>'12345-'.($password-1),'account_list'=>$path];
        } catch(Throwable $error) {
            $db->rollback();
            if(is_resource($file))fclose($file);
            if($pending && is_file($pending))unlink($pending);
            throw $error;
        } finally {
            pu_query($db,"SELECT RELEASE_LOCK(CONCAT(DATABASE(),':gable_demo_seed'))");
        }
    }
    
    if(realpath($_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME']??'')===__FILE__) {
        try {
            $catalog=json_decode(file_get_contents(__DIR__.'/demo-catalog.json'),true,512,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            $result=seed_demo_accounts(getConnection(),$catalog,dirname(__DIR__,3).'/gable-private');
            echo json_encode($result,JSON_PRETTY_PRINT|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES).PHP_EOL;
        } catch(Throwable $error) {
            fwrite(STDERR,'Account setup failed: '.$error->getMessage().PHP_EOL);exit(1);
        }
    }
